subject: Onramp & MAP: SOC 2 timing, SIG, DPA redline, and retention window

Date: Thu, 15 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onramp & MAP: SOC 2 timing, SIG, DPA redline, and retention window

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our call, I want to scope a short mutual action plan (MAP) that covers the security gates Aurora needs to complete evaluation and reach an acceptance decision. High level asks we discussed: SOC 2 Type II evidence, SIG/CAIQ questionnaire, finalized DPA with the requested retention window, and a short runbook for evidence access during the pilot.

I attached a draft MAP (Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx) with milestones; below is a condensed timeline proposal so you can share with procurement and your security team: 

- Week 0 (this week): Exchange final DPA redline (Aurora to share) and confirm targeted retention window.
- Week 1–2: Redwood to provide SIG answers + SOC 2 artifacts (we will provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and control narratives).
- Week 3: Evidence sprint (screen share + live walkthrough) and on-demand access to logs for scoped pilot queries.
- Week 4: Final acceptance decision / roll to pilot.

Two immediate clarifications we need from Aurora: 1) the maximum allowable data retention (requested currently 7 years on your redline vs our standard 1 year — please confirm business requirement), and 2) whether you need escrow or HSM key escrow language in the DPA.

I've cc'd Jordan and Marcus from our GTM/security ops to help coordinate the evidence sprint and DPA path. Next steps: if you can upload your DPA redline and confirm the retention requirement, we'll lock the MAP dates and schedule the evidence walkthrough.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft, milestones)
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@aurorabank.com>

Date: Thu, 15 Nov 2028 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onramp & MAP: SOC 2 timing, SIG, DPA redline, and retention window

Soojin —

This is helpful, thank you. Quick responses from our side:

- Retention window: regulator requires up to 5 years for transaction logs; 7 years is negotiable if we can carve scope to only keep aggregated telemetry beyond 1 year. I'll confirm with legal but please assume 5 years as the baseline.
- DPA redline: attaching our procurement redline (DPA_redline_Aurora_v3.docx). Main ask: more explicit audit timing and the right to request evidence within 48 hours.
- SOC 2: we prefer unredacted but we understand constraints; redacted Type II is acceptable during evaluation as long as it includes control test results and the period covered.

We'll upload the DPA and a short note from legal in ~24 hours. Can you confirm the type of SOC 2 artifact and whether the SIG CAIQ will be an abbreviated response or full matrix?

Thanks,

Hannah Li
Senior InfoSec Manager, Aurora Bank
hannah.li@aurorabank.com
From: soojin.lee@redwood.ai

Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Nov 2028 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onramp & MAP: SOC 2 timing, SIG, DPA redline, and retention window

Hi Hannah —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps from our side:

1) SOC 2 artifacts: we'll provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report (full control descriptions + test results) and an accompanying control narrative packet. For the purposes of your acceptance decision we can grant a secure, time-limited view of the unredacted report under an NDA if your legal requires it — please flag if you want that route.

2) SIG/CAIQ: we'll deliver a prioritized CAIQ with evidence mappings (abridged answers for common cloud controls) plus a full machine-readable matrix on request. I'm attaching the abridged PDF (SIG-CAIQ-answers-abridged.pdf) for your initial review.

3) DPA: thanks for the redline — Jordan, can you take ownership of an internal review and coordinate a single mark we can send back by Monday? Marcus, can you confirm whether we can accept a 5-year retention window for the specific transaction logs carve you mentioned (aggregated telemetry will stay at our default 1 year)?

4) Evidence walkthrough: propose we schedule a 60m session during Week 3 for the evidence sprint. Lauren, please propose 3 windows next week for Aurora to pick from.

If Aurora confirms 5 years and signs the MAP, we can keep the timeline and target pilot in 4 weeks.

Best,

Soojin

Subject: RE: Onramp & MAP: SOC 2 timing, SIG, DPA redline, and retention window

Hannah / team —

Quick update from our legal/security review on DPA_redline_Aurora_v3.docx: attached is a single internal mark (we uploaded SOC2-Type2-2028.zip and SIG-CAIQ-answers-abridged.pdf to the Drive link) and a proposed DPA compromise:

- Retention: accept 5-year retention for scoped transaction logs, provided Aurora narrows the scope to PII-less aggregated event logs plus transaction IDs hashed with a per-customer salt (we included acceptable language in our mark).
- Audit/evidence timing: we can commit to an evidence access SLA of 72 hours for the pilot (48 hours is hard for our SOC operations team during business peaks). We can include a one-off exception clause for critical incidents to meet a 48-hour demand with prior notice.
- Escrow/key language: HSM integration is supported; we cannot offer third-party escrow for keys in the hosted product without an enterprise contract addendum.

Requesting Aurora to confirm whether the 72-hour window is acceptable for the pilot or if procurement requires 48 hours as a non-negotiable term — that will determine whether we route this to an enterprise exceptions approval.

Next steps: Lauren, please coordinate the evidence sprint calendar with Aurora. Soojin, I'll push the single-mark DPA back to them with our proposed language and the Drive link to the artifacts.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Sr. Legal Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: DPA_Redline_Redwood_mark.docx (internal mark), SOC2-Type2-2028.zip (redacted report + narratives), SIG-CAIQ-answers-abridged.pdf
